segments.narration: Technical walkthrough for LeaseLaw Navigator, track two RealPage.
Module A is extraction. We scan the official starter corpus, propose rules, and drop any quote that is not a literal substring of the source file.
Module B matches addresses. We map postal cities to legal cities, then evaluate year built, units, and certificate dates. Missing facts yield need more information, not a guess.
Module C exports changes dot JSON for tests T one through T five on five hundred addresses, plus rules and lookups in submission shape.
In the terminal, python three minus m src dot eval harness exits zero with five of five tests and ten of ten gold cases. The Docker image bundles the starter pack and runs the same check.
Production is on Render. The public repo includes output JSON and a README with reproduce steps. Live API and UI serve the same engine.
